form.label: Incident Response & Forensics
form.description: Post-compromise investigation, lateral movement analysis, and data exfiltration detection

search.query: index=* host=$host_token$ | eval event_category=case( sourcetype IN ("linux_secure", "WinEventLog:Security"), "Authentication", sourcetype IN ("WinEventLog:Sysmon", "linux:audit"), "Process Execution", sourcetype IN ("zeek:conn", "zeek:http", "zeek:dns"), "Network Activity", sourcetype IN ("wazuh:alerts"), "Wazuh Alert", sourcetype IN ("iptables"), "Firewall Block", 1=1, sourcetype ) | table _time, event_category, sourcetype, user, src_ip, dest_ip, _raw | sort _time | rename _time as "Time", event_category as "Category", sourcetype as "Source Type", user as "User", src_ip as "Source IP", dest_ip as "Dest IP", _raw as "Event Details" | head 1000

(index=network sourcetype=zeek:conn service IN ("ssh", "rdp", "smb")) OR (index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure "Accepted") OR (index=windows EventCode=4624 Logon_Type IN (3,10)) | eval movement_type=case( service=="ssh" OR match(_raw, "ssh"), "SSH", service=="rdp" OR Logon_Type==10, "RDP", service=="smb" OR Logon_Type==3, "SMB/Network", 1=1, "Other" ) | stats count as connections, earliest(_time) as first_seen, latest(_time) as last_seen by src_ip, dest_ip, movement_type | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort first_seen | rename src_ip as "Source IP", dest_ip as "Target IP", movement_type as "Method", connections as "Connections", first_seen as "First Seen", last_seen as "Last Seen" | head 100

index=network sourcetype=zeek:conn | where orig_bytes > 10485760 | stats sum(orig_bytes) as total_bytes_out, count as connections by id.orig_h, id.resp_h, id.resp_p | eval total_MB=round(total_bytes_out/1024/1024, 2) | where total_MB > 50 | sort -total_MB | rename id.orig_h as "Source IP", id.resp_h as "Destination IP", id.resp_p as "Dest Port", total_MB as "Data Out (MB)", connections as "Connections" | head 50

index=network sourcetype=zeek:conn | where resp_bytes > 10485760 | stats sum(resp_bytes) as total_bytes_in, count as connections by id.orig_h, id.resp_h, id.resp_p | eval total_MB=round(total_bytes_in/1024/1024, 2) | where total_MB > 50 | sort -total_MB | rename id.orig_h as "Receiving Host", id.resp_h as "Source IP", id.resp_p as "Source Port", total_MB as "Data In (MB)", connections as "Connections" | head 50

index=network sourcetype=zeek:dns | eval query_length=len(query) | stats count as query_count, avg(query_length) as avg_length, dc(query) as unique_queries by id.orig_h, query | where query_count > 500 OR avg_length > 60 | sort -query_count | rename id.orig_h as "Source IP", query as "Domain", query_count as "Query Count", avg_length as "Avg Query Length", unique_queries as "Unique Queries" | head 30

index=linux sourcetype=cowrie | spath | eval attack_detail=case( isnotnull(username), "Credential: " . username . "/" . password, isnotnull(input), "Command: " . input, isnotnull(url), "Download: " . url, 1=1, message ) | stats count, values(attack_detail) as "Attack Details" by src_ip, session | sort -count | rename src_ip as "Attacker IP", session as "Session ID", count as "Events" | head 50

index=network sourcetype=zeek:conn | where id.resp_p NOT IN (80, 443, 53, 22, 25, 110, 143, 993, 995) | stats count as conn_count, sum(orig_bytes) as bytes_out by id.orig_h, id.resp_h, id.resp_p, proto | eval bytes_out_MB=round(bytes_out/1024/1024, 2) | where conn_count > 10 OR bytes_out_MB > 10 | sort -conn_count | rename id.orig_h as "Source IP", id.resp_h as "Dest IP", id.resp_p as "Dest Port", proto as "Protocol", conn_count as "Connections", bytes_out_MB as "Data Out (MB)" | head 50
